content:
We've completed the first stages of the move from leanprover/std4 to leanprover-community/batteries.

Mathlib has been updated.

If you've got a project with dependencies on this library, the next time you run lake update, you'll get a message about needing to update your require statement.

You need to update any import Std.X statements to import Batteries.X. You will likely need to update opening namespaces from Std to Batteries too. There are deprecation aliases in place (although not for any of the tactics in Std).

Further discussion in https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/348111-std4/topic/Std.20-.3E.20Boost.20migration
